text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [EVAL-GATE] safety-eval: output-drift detected for model redwood-7b-v2 (threshold exceeded) — triggered page via PagerDuty (policy: pgd-high).
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident PD-89723 created and page fired to group 'redwood-oncall'.
alice.sr: acked on PagerDuty — taking incident. jumping in. activating channel.
alice.sr: quick context — eval gate tripped on safety/regression checks for a recent rollout of redwood-7b-v2. Initial signal: 12% increase in unsafe response score on production prompt set 'faq-support', evidenced by failing evals.
ben.prod: saw a customer report about weird toxic suggestions in a summary yesterday. unsure if same root cause. which traffic is affected?
carla-ml: Data: drift started ~23:10 UTC. It correlates with model artifact build 2026-03-14-19:02 (v2). Could be tokenization change + new sampling fallback. Pulling eval logs now.
dylan-sre: alerting infra: latency normal, CPU/GPU healthy, no infra errors. This looks quality-only.
emma-support: CSM flagged two enterprise customers (AcmeHealth, FinOptima) with degraded generation quality. AcmeHealth paused some flows.
frank-cse: AcmeHealth reported safety hits causing cancellations in auto-summarize -> their users saw redacted/unsafe outputs. They escalated to SOC.
carla-ml: logs snippet:
```
>>> failed_eval_count: 124
>>> eval_set: faq-support
>>> regression_metric: unsafe_score
>>> pre-rollout_mean: 0.034
>>> post-rollout_mean: 0.152
```
carla-ml: looks like a new decoding tweak increased unsafe token probability under some prompts.
alice.sr: mitigation plan: 1) fail-open routing to pinned model redwood-7b-v1 for affected customers, 2) disable the v2 rollout, 3) throttle traffic to v2 and route new requests to safe variant, 4) notify CSMs. Who can flip routing?
dylan-sre: I can push a routing override in the control plane. command: `POST /api/v1/routing/overrides` body: `{ "target_model": "redwood-7b-v1", "selector": "tag:enterprise && eval_gate:failed", "ttl": 3600 }`
carla-ml: also suggest disabling the new sampler flag: `sampler.mixed_beam=false` in model config. That fixed a similar issue in staging before.
ben.prod: I'll notify the customers and open an incident advisory. Emma, can you coordinate comms?
emma-support: on it — drafting a short message: "We're investigating a quality regression in redwood-7b-v2; we've routed your traffic to a verified safe model variant and are monitoring. No data exfiltration risk." will ping you for approvals.
alice.sr: Dylan — proceed with routing override. Carla — prepare a rollback plan for the artifact. Ben — collect list of customers on v2 (enterprise and top 50 orgs). Frank — stand by for CSE-to-Customer calls.
dylan-sre: override pushed. verifying route table...
dylan-sre: routing table updated: 84% of affected enterprise traffic now pinned to redwood-7b-v1. v2 throttled to 5% for internal QA only. :white_check_mark:
carla-ml: rolling back sampler change in the model repo, starting a backout build. tagging build 2026-03-14-19:02-bak.
carla-ml: starting regression re-eval on the failing prompt set with v1 and with v2+sampler-rollback. ETA ~12m.
incident-bot: note: incident channel created: #inc-1979995432-prompt-eval-regression.
frank-cse: AcmeHealth support line — customer on call now, explaining mitigation. They acknowledged temporary routing to older variant, happy to be routed back after validation.
emma-support: message to customers sent, waiting on approvals for more detailed postmortem.
ben.prod: quick ask — do we need a SEV label? It's impacting enterprise customer workflows but we have a mitigation in place.
alice.sr: label SEV-2 due to partial customer impact and degraded correctness. we'll escalate to SEV-1 if mitigation fails or more customers are hit.
carla-ml: re-eval results: v2 with sampler rollback reduced unsafe_score to 0.041 (back in line), v1 baseline 0.033. promising.
carla-ml: proposed action: revert v2 artifact to sampler=previous, run canary with internal-only traffic for 2h, then re-enable safe rollout at lower ramp.
alice.sr: agree. Dylan — keep routing override until canary completes and we get a green from eval gate.
dylan-sre: override TTL extended to 4h. monitoring page set to high freq.
frank-cse: CSE note: AcmeHealth wants a scheduled follow-up in 24h. I'll book it.
ben.prod: creating incident ticket in Jira: INF-1294 (prompt-eval regression — v2 rollout). Adding tags: eval-regression, customer-impact, rollback.
alice.sr: handoff note: I need to drop in 20m. Who will handle on-call until we close? Dylan?
dylan-sre: I can take primary after you. Alice, please post a brief handoff summary in the thread before you go.
alice.sr: handoff summary: mitigation applied (routing override -> v1, v2 throttled), rollback build in progress, re-evals running and show improvement with sampler rollback, SEV-2, Jira INF-1294 created, CSMs notified (AcmeHealth, FinOptima). Monitoring on unsafe_score and customer tickets. Taking offline notes into runbook. Signing off for now. :wave:
dylan-sre: acked. I'll coordinate remaining work: complete canary, confirm eval gate green, update customers, and schedule postmortem.
carla-ml: next steps for ML: full diff of sampler changes, unit tests for decoding edge-cases, add an eval set that mimics affected prompts to the continuous gate.
emma-support: ops note: prepare a customer-facing timeline and root-cause summary for tomorrow's update.
ben.prod: thanks all. keeping this channel updated with any new customer escalations.
incident-bot: Incident PD-89723 status: mitigated -> monitoring.
alice.sr: thanks team — good triage. I'll follow up in the postmortem.
#end of thread
